Name: Jas and Vincent's Shop
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
[b]Jas and Vincent's shop.
[/b]V1: Jas and Vincent have decided to open their own shop selling forageables to earn some fun money. Their shop can be bought at Robin's. Building changes colors with the season. Matches my other seasonal mods. 
The shop can be accessed 24/7 without Jas or Vincent having to be there. Click on the robot helper. 
You will get a letter from Lewis and then Robin letting you know you can buy the shop. After having the shop for a while you will get a thank you from Jas and Vincent. [b] You have to have 4 hearts with both Jas and Vincent before the shop shows up.

[/b]V2: Jas and Vincent's shop is next to Marnie's ranch. No need to build it. You can choose to have Jas and Vincent go to the shop, Monday and Thursday. 

Choose and load only one version. V2 does not work with PolyCarts. V2 is on 3.5.0 while V1 is on 3.0.0. 

Jas and Vincent's Shop sells seasonal forageables. Some items are sold year-round such as wood. The shop also sells beach forageables  such as clams. (Full list of items below).



[b]Translations[/b]
Translations are welcome. Please let me know and link the translation to this mod.
Chinese Translation by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/passersby10086]passersby10086[/url]

[b]Insulation[/b]
1. Download and Install the Latest Version of SMAPI.﻿﻿
2. Download and Extract Content Patcher mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.
3. Download and Extract [b]Jas and Vincent’s Shop[/b] into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.﻿﻿﻿
4. Launch Stardew Valley. 

I hope you enjoy this mod and take a look at my other mods.
[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/sadnumbme?gameId=1303]sadnumbme[/url]
